name: Sparkle Button
description: Monochrome generate button with staggered per-character blur-in text, a width spring between labels, and a pulsing sparkle icon while loading.
summary: A generation trigger with per-character blur-in text, a blur-and-fade swap between the idle label ("Generate Magic") and the loading label ("Generating..."), a width spring between them, and a sparkle icon that pulses while loading. Comes in default, outline and glass variants.
highlights: Staggered per-character blur-in when the label changes
Old label exits with blur and fade over dissolveDuration while the width springs (stiffness 350, damping 28, mass 0.8) to the new label
Sparkle icon pulses (scale 1 to 1.15 with a glow) on a 1.6s easeInOut loop while loading
Monochromatic deep tactile bevel with multi-stop black and white composite inset shadows and upper specular reflection
Three precision size scales (sm, default, lg) with automatic vector scaling
Full keyboard focus ring and accessible ARIA state support
anatomy: <div> (Ambient layout container for the interactive button)
<button> (Focus-visible tactile pill container with monochromatic inset bevel lighting)
<motion.svg> (Pulsing tri-star magic sparkle vector with soft ambient glow)
<AnimatePresence> (Handles seamless blur and fade crossfade between idle and active states)
<span> (Individual character glyph with a staggered blur-in)

physics.description: Staggered character blur-in, a width spring between labels, and a looping icon pulse while loading.

accessibility.aria: A native button. aria-busy is true while isLoading is set; the decorative sparkle layers are aria-hidden.
accessibility.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion, the per-character blur-in, the loading pulse and the width spring are skipped.

keyboard.description: Activate. Uncontrolled: toggles the loading state. Controlled: calls onLoadingChange.

recommended: Primary AI prompt submission and content generation triggers
Creative workflow controls in image, video, or code generation interfaces
Minimalist, monochromatic hero call-to-actions needing tactile, magical feedback
bestPractices: Pair with real backend generation callbacks via loading and onLoadingChange props
Keep the monochromatic palette intact for clean developer and dark-mode aesthetics
Keep text and activeText short so the width spring stays tight

props.name: text
props.description: Idle label rendered with BlurText staggered reveal animation.

props.name: activeText
props.description: Active label displayed when generating with smooth fade & blur reveal.

props.name: animateBy
props.description: Whether blur reveal staggers by individual letters or full words.

props.name: direction
props.description: Direction from which blurred glyphs drift into place.

props.name: delay
props.description: Stagger delay between sequential elements in milliseconds.

props.name: stepDuration
props.description: Reveal transition duration for each letter or word in seconds.

props.name: dissolveDuration
props.description: Fade and blur dissolve duration when exiting previous text state.

props.name: springStiffness
props.description: Stiffness parameter for the button's layout resizing spring animation.

props.name: springDamping
props.description: Damping parameter for the button's layout resizing spring animation.

props.name: loading
props.description: Controlled generation state. When undefined, toggles automatically on click.

props.name: size
props.description: Button dimensions, font sizes, and icon scaling.

props.name: icon
props.description: Custom icon. Replaces the default sparkle icon.

props.name: onLoadingChange
props.description: Callback triggered when generation state changes.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to override dimensions or margins.
